posts.title: Extensible, personal software is the sweet spot for LLMs
posts.description: I've been thinking about how awesome it is to use software that is easy to extend with LLMs (like Pi and Herdr). They have some properties that make using them feel like magic. But what are those properties?

posts.title: Don’t niche down. Position yourself.
posts.description: I've always heard it said, "Niche down!" But that never felt right to me. Instead of niching down, position yourself.

posts.title: Diverge then converge with LLMs
posts.description: One of the patterns I've found particularly helpful with LLMs is the diverge-then-converge pattern. LLMs excel at both of those things separately, and when we put them together, they are an excellent tool to help us solve problems.
